description: Library Maintenance's Duplicates tab on the movie index, as admin at 1366 px and on a phone. The status line shows the index GET /LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Index returns (its movies, libraries and entries, with Jellyfin's own movie count beside it), the libraries table lists each library's movies, and Rebuild posts …/Index/Rebuild once, turns itself off (aria-disabled, so it keeps the focus) while the build runs and shows the newer index when it is done. Changes only the plugin's in-memory index.

steps.name: the probe's helpers
an index to show: built once if the server has none yet
steps.eval: (async () => { let index = (await __lmIndex.api('GET', 'LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Index')).body; if (!index.Version) { await __lmIndex.api('POST', 'LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Index/Rebuild'); for (let i = 0; i < 300 && (!index.Version || index.Rebuilding); i++) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); index = (await __lmIndex.api('GET', 'LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Index')).body; } } const movies = (await __lmIndex.api('GET', 'Items?Recursive=true&IncludeItemTypes=Movie&Limit=0&userId=' + ApiClient.getCurrentUserId())).body.TotalRecordCount; return { version: index.Version, movies: index.Movies, entries: index.Entries, libraries: index.Libraries.length, jellyfinMovies: movies }; })()

steps.name: the index holds every movie Jellyfin lists
what the tab shows
steps.eval: (p => ({ status: __lmIndex.status(), libraries: [...p.querySelectorAll('#LibraryMaintenanceDuplicatesDetails tr')].map(r => [...r.children].map(c => c.textContent)), banners: [...p.querySelectorAll('#LibraryMaintenanceDuplicatesBanners [role]')].map(b => b.textContent), rebuildDisabled: p.querySelector('#LibraryMaintenanceDuplicatesRebuild').disabled || p.querySelector('#LibraryMaintenanceDuplicatesRebuild').getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' }))(__lmIndex.page())

steps.name: the status line has the index's counts, a row per library, Rebuild enabled
the build done and shown: Rebuild enabled again, a newer index on the server
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const p = __lmIndex.page(); const index = (await __lmIndex.api('GET', 'LibraryMaintenance/Duplicates/Index')).body; return index.Version > __vars.before.version && !index.Rebuilding && p.querySelector('#LibraryMaintenanceDuplicatesRebuild').getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'false' && /^Index: /.test(__lmIndex.status()) && !p.querySelector('#LibraryMaintenanceDuplicatesBanners').textContent; })()
